en:
Shuichi, may I ask you for advice concerning
a particular matter?

Advice?
Are you sure want to ask...me?

Yes. In fact, you are the only one I can talk
to about this matter.
<CLT=cltMIND>The only one?

This question has been on my mind for a
while now...

Do you think I am merely ordinary, despite
being the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Robot<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

...No, you don't need to answer. Compared
to everyone else, I feel rather ordinary.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Then why ask?

So I've been thinking that I need to address
this somehow by taking action.
Shuichi, I intend to...launch a robot business!
A robot business?

Yes, I'm going to launch a business that takes
full advantage of my robot capabilities.

That's why...I'm going to work to become
a pop star robot!
A pop star? Why that?

I arrived at this decision after analyzing
many options.

The main reason...is that robots have yet to
advance in the pop music genre.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think they've advanced
in *any* music genre...
It's the singing
It's their looks
It's the dancing
Are you unsure of something?

On the subject of pop stars... Singing is
what they're mostly known for, right?
Yes, it's the singing.

As a robot, I should be able to sing once
I upload the proper music and lyrics.

In that regard, I believe I am well suited
to the role of pop star.
I see. You've put a lot of thought into this.
Of course!

Furthermore, pop stars fill the opposite sex
with admiration, joy, and a reason to live.

It's the perfect way for me to gain a deeper
understanding of the emotion, "happiness."
It's their looks.
Looks, huh...?

I suppose I could alter my appearance
to a certain extent...

But I don't want to change how the professor
designed me. Singing is how I will stand out!
It's the dancing.
Dancing, huh?
Ah, are you...bad at dancing?
I wouldn't say I'm bad at dancing.

It's just...for some reason, my dancing always
seems to turn into the robot dance...

I see... Perhaps being an
idol is not for you...
That's why singing is how I'll stand out!

I'm going to sing for you now.
Please tell me what you think.
Alright, sure.
<CLT=cltMIND>I would soon regret those words.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo's expression while singing was
so peaceful, so joyous...
Ah! Ah!!! Aaauuuggghhh!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>But my brain was being fried!
I felt like my insides were scrambling!

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't block it out!
I'm gonna throw up!
Augh! Urgh... Blarghhh!

<CLT=cltMIND>Several minutes later...
I opened my eyes, still hunched over.

What do you think, Shuichi?
It was pretty good, huh?

I'm sorry, Keebo... I don't think I can...
follow your music career...
Huh? What do you mean?

Keebo...your singing...was terrible...
I couldn't take it...
Wha—!? Was it really that bad!?

Yes... I ah...don't think you should
sing for people anymore...

Oh no... Does that mean I can't become
a pop star?

...Ah! Wait, Keebo,
that's it!

You can play music, right?
Why don't you do that?

If you just pretended to sing and played
the song through your mouth...
I can't do that!
What?
That is an illogical compromise, Shuichi!

Please understand, my AI is a reflection of
the human desire for greater understanding.

So I must experience the hardship of training!
The easy path will only hinder my progress!

Even if one possesses an Ultimate-level
talent...

That talent should not be a crutch, but a
stepping stone to reach even greater heights!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>K1-B0's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo gave me a dressing-down,
and I returned to my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>I never thought the day would come when
a robot would preach to a human.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, come to think of it...we didn't
come to a conclusion about his robot business.
